dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You must have a whole bunch of questions after our last conversation with Nahida? Paimon was ready to ask her a million more questions, but... didn't wanna seem too pushy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like, about these "Descenders." So... does that just mean people like you, who come traveling to Teyvat from someplace else?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #And as for your {M#sister}{F#brother}... whew, so many questions. Let's go find Nahida and see what else we can find out.
